description: This Rust source file implements a WebSocket server for VISSv2 protocol using the Axum framework. It handles WebSocket upgrade requests, manages WebSocket connections, processes incoming VISSv2 requests (GET, SET, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE), and sends appropriate responses and notifications. The code includes connection handling, message parsing, response serialization, and concurrent task management for reading and writing WebSocket streams.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Holds shared application state including broker and authorization components.

methods.name: serve( addr: impl Into<std::net::SocketAddr>, broker: broker::DataBroker, authorization: Authorization, ) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>>
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket server listening on the specified address with given broker and authorization handlers.

methods.name: handle_upgrade( ws: WebSocketUpgrade, axum::extract::ConnectInfo(addr): axum::extract::ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>, axum::extract::State(state): axum::extract::State<AppState>, ) -> impl IntoResponse
methods.description: Handles WebSocket upgrade requests, validating subprotocol and initiating websocket connection handling.

methods.name: handle_websocket( socket: WebSocket, addr: SocketAddr, broker: broker::DataBroker, authorization: Authorization, )
methods.description: Manages an individual WebSocket connection, validating protocol and spawning read/write tasks.

methods.name: handle_viss_v2<W, R>( write: W, mut read: R, client_addr: SocketAddr, broker: broker::DataBroker, authorization: Authorization, ) where W: Sink<Message> + Unpin + Send + 'static, <W as Sink<Message>>::Error: Send, R: Stream<Item = Result<Message, axum::Error>> + Unpin + Send + 'static,
methods.description: Processes messages over an active WebSocket connection, handling different message types (text, binary, close, ping, pong). It routes requests to the VISSv2 server, handles subscriptions, and manages notification streams.

methods.name: parse_v2_msg(msg: &str) -> Result<v2::Request, v2::GenericErrorResponse>
methods.description: Parses incoming JSON strings into VISSv2 request objects, with error handling for malformed messages.

methods.name: serialize(response: impl v2::Response) -> Result<String, serde_json::Error>
methods.description: Serializes VISSv2 response objects into JSON string format for sending over WebSocket.
